en.headline: A question between you.
en.intro: Conversation cards for a shared table, a familiar friend, or a moment with yourself.
en.concept_title: One card. Room for an answer.
en.concept: Pick a pack for the people and moment in front of you. Read one question, listen to the answer, and move on when you are ready. The app guides the prompts; the conversation happens between you.
en.demo_title: From the actual Confidence Boost pack
en.demo_note: These questions come directly from the bundled app data. This small preview has no account, saved answers, or AI request.
en.energy_title: Two shapes, two kinds of question.
en.energy_intro: The rounded and pointed marks describe a question’s energy. They are not a score or a personality type.
energy_items: Curiosity, detail, and story. An invitation to expand an answer.
A tension or contradiction. An invitation to look beyond a rehearsed answer.
en.research: The names borrow from the bouba/kiki sound-shape association: people often pair “bouba” with rounded shapes and “kiki” with pointed ones. Ćwiek et al.’s cross-language study examines that association. Using the shapes for conversation energy is this app’s design metaphor, not a tested relationship intervention.
features: Guest mode opens a single pack straight into questions. Packs span self-reflection, friends, partners, family, and imagined situations. Change the language to change both interface and available packs.
After signing in, Customize lets you combine packs, choose categories, and set the proportion of questions. Chaos Shuffle mixes non-ending questions across categories; ending cards stay at the close.
My Topics opens a card-based editor for categories, questions, reverse-side notes, and closing cards. Personal topics stay private until submitted for Community review.
steps: In guest mode, browse the library and open a pack that fits the moment.
Use Previous and Next, or the left and right arrow keys. On touch devices, swipe horizontally. Cards with extra notes can flip.
On mobile, Alternate card direction can rotate every other card toward the person across the table. Switch it in Settings.
en.gallery_title: The real app, in guest mode.
captions: A built-in question from Confidence Boost.
The scrollable pack library in guest mode.
Language, appearance, and alternate card direction.
en.start: Built-in quick play needs no sign-in. Accounts unlock Community interactions, pack mixing, and your own saved topics. Authentication, topics, and likes use Supabase when configured.
en.ai: The topic editor can draft cards through a provider you choose. Your prompt and settings are sent to that provider; the key is used for that request and is not saved by Cards. The introduction preview never calls a model.
en.local_note: The standalone introduction builds with Python only. The app uses Vite; backend features require the project’s documented Supabase configuration.
en.footer: A Frankie project by Songhai Fan

zh.headline: 把问题，放在你们之间。
zh.intro: 为同桌的人、熟悉的朋友，或独处的片刻，翻开一张对话卡。
zh.concept_title: 一张卡片，留出回答的空间。
zh.concept: 根据眼前的人和当下的情境选择卡包。读出一个问题，听听对方的回答，准备好后再进入下一张。应用提供提问的线索，对话仍发生在你们之间。
zh.demo_title: 来自真实「自信加油站」卡包
zh.demo_note: 问题直接读取项目内置数据。这是无账号、不保存回答、不会请求 AI 的小预览。
zh.energy_title: 两种形状，两种提问的力量。
zh.energy_intro: 圆润与尖锐的标记描述问题的表达方式，不是评分，也不是人格分类。
energy_items: 带着好奇、细节与故事，让回答自然展开。
指出一种张力或矛盾，邀请你越过习惯性的回答。
zh.research: 名称借用 bouba/kiki 的声音与形状联结：人们常把 bouba 与圆润形状、kiki 与尖锐形状配对。Ćwiek 等人的跨语言研究讨论了这一现象。把形状用于描述对话能量，是本应用的设计隐喻，并非经过验证的关系干预。
features: 访客打开单个卡包即可直接进入问题。主题涵盖自我回顾、朋友、伴侣、家庭与想象情境。切换语言会同时改变界面与可用卡包。
登录后进入自定义模式，可混合卡包、筛选分类并调整抽取比例。混沌洗牌会打散非结束问题的分类顺序，结束卡仍放在最后。
「我的话题」提供卡片式编辑器，可编写分类、问题、背面说明与结束卡。个人话题默认私有，提交社区后需经审核才能公开。
steps: 在访客模式浏览卡包，打开适合此刻的主题。
使用上一张、下一张，或键盘左右方向键。触屏可横向滑动；带补充说明的卡片可以翻面。
手机上可在设置中开启「交替卡片方向」，让每隔一张的卡片转向桌子对面的人。
zh.gallery_title: 访客模式下的真实应用。
captions: 可滚动浏览的访客卡包库。
语言、外观与交替卡片方向设置。
zh.start: 内置卡包的快速体验不需要登录。账号用于社区互动、混合卡包与保存个人话题。配置后，认证、话题与点赞由 Supabase 提供服务。
zh.ai: 话题编辑器可通过你选择的模型服务草拟卡片。提示词与设置会发送给该服务；密钥仅用于请求，Cards 不会保存。本介绍页的预览不会调用模型。
zh.local_note: 介绍页仅需 Python 独立构建。应用使用 Vite；后端功能需要按项目文档配置 Supabase。
zh.footer: Songhai Fan 的 Frankie 系列项目
